pests.symptoms: Dead hearts in vegetative stage; white ears at heading. Hollow stems with feeding tunnels.
pests.economic_threshold: 5% dead hearts OR 1% white ears
pests.biological_control: Release Trichogramma japonicum egg parasitoids (1 lakh/acre) at 15-day intervals. Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens (2.5 kg/acre). Use light traps to monitor adult moth populations.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Flubendiamide 20% WG @ 10 g/15L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 3 ml/15L. Apply only when ETL is crossed.

pests.symptoms: Longitudinally folded leaves with transparent streaks — 'white streaks' on leaf surface.
pests.economic_threshold: 10% leaf damage OR 2 moths/trap/night
pests.biological_control: Spray NSKE (Neem Seed Kernel Extract) 5% — 25 kg neem seeds/250L water/acre. Release Cotesia flavipes parasitoid wasps. Install 12 bird perches per acre for natural predation.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Cartap hydrochloride 50% SP @ 400g/acre. Use only during severe outbreaks after scouting confirms ETL breach.

pests.symptoms: Stunted growth, yellowing, characteristic root galls/knots, reduced tillering.
pests.economic_threshold: Presence of galls on roots during nursery stage
pests.biological_control: Apply Purpureocillium lilacinum (Paecilomyces) — 2.5 kg/acre as soil amendment. Mix Neem cake at 250 kg/acre in nursery soil. Use Pochonia chlamydosporia (egg parasitic fungus) as biocontrol.
pests.chemical_control: Apply Carbofuran 3G granules @ 5 kg/acre in nursery beds. Use Fluopyram nematicide if damage is severe and biological methods fail.

pests.symptoms: Windowpane feeding on young leaves, 'shot-hole' damage, ragged leaf margins. Frass (excrement) visible in whorl. Inverted 'Y' mark on caterpillar head.
pests.economic_threshold: 5% whorl damage or 1 larva per plant in vegetative stage
pests.biological_control: Apply Metarhizium anisopliae (2.5 kg/acre) or Beauveria bassiana (2.5 kg/acre) — entomopathogenic fungi. Spray NSKE 5% in whorl stage. Use border cropping with cowpea/sunflower as trap crop. Encourage natural predators: ground beetles, spiders.
pests.chemical_control: Treat seeds with Cyantraniliprole + Thiamethoxam. Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 3 ml/15L into whorl at early infestation. Apply in evening when larvae are feeding.

pests.symptoms: Curling and crinkling of leaves, yellowing, honeydew secretion leading to sooty mold. Stunted plant growth.
pests.economic_threshold: 10 aphids per leaf OR 10 jassids per 3 leaves
pests.biological_control: Release Chrysoperla carnea (green lacewing) eggs — 50,000/acre. Install yellow sticky traps (10/acre). Spray insecticidal soap or neem oil (3 ml/L) as preventive. Encourage parasitic wasps by avoiding broad-spectrum sprays.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 3 ml/15L for initial control. Follow with Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 2g/15L for severe outbreaks.

pests.symptoms: Entry holes with frass at square/boll base. Internal boll damage, premature boll shedding. Pink staining of lint.
pests.economic_threshold: 5% damaged squares or 5% damaged bolls
pests.biological_control: Install pheromone traps (5/acre) for population monitoring. Make inundative releases of Trichogrammatoidea bactrae (egg parasitoid) — 2 lakh/acre. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) kurstaki formulation early in the season.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG or Spinosad 45 SC @ 3 ml/15L. Rotate chemistry to prevent resistance development.

pests.symptoms: Wilting and death of seedlings at collar region. Brown water-soaked lesions on stem base. White mycelial growth. Damping off.
pests.economic_threshold: 5% plant mortality in field
pests.biological_control: Treat seeds with Trichoderma viride (4 g/kg seed) before sowing. Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens as foliar spray after emergence. Grow castor as trap crop on borders.
pests.chemical_control: Drench soil with Carbendazim 50 WP @ 2g/L at collar region. Apply only on confirmed disease spots, not blanket treatment.

pests.symptoms: Curling leaves, vector for groundnut rosette virus. Silvering of leaf surface (thrips). Reduced pod setting.
pests.economic_threshold: 50 aphids per plant or visible virus symptoms
pests.biological_control: Set up yellow sticky traps (10/acre) and pheromone traps. Install light traps (2/acre) for moth monitoring. Spray NSKE 5% as preventive measure.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 2 ml/15L or Dimethoate 30 EC @ 10 ml/15L for severe infestation.

pests.symptoms: Scarring and russeting of fruit skin (corky appearance). Silvering of leaf undersurface. Distorted banana fingers.
pests.economic_threshold: 10 thrips per leaf or visible fruit scarring
pests.biological_control: Use disease-free suckers from certified sources. Apply Neem cake at 250 kg/acre at planting. Maintain field hygiene by removing dried leaves promptly.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 10 ml/15L or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL. For severe cases, use stem injection of systemic insecticides.

pests.symptoms: Yellow streaks evolving into brown necrotic spots with yellow halo on leaves. Premature leaf death reduces photosynthesis and bunch weight.
pests.economic_threshold: Appearance of spots on 3rd leaf from top
pests.biological_control: Apply Trichoderma viride (2.5 kg/acre) as soil drench. Spray copper-based bioformulations. Remove infected leaf portions promptly.
pests.chemical_control: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L at 21-day intervals. Alternate fungicides to prevent resistance.

pests.symptoms: Circular holes in fruits with frass. Entry at calyx end. Larvae inside fruit — causes complete fruit loss. Can destroy 60-80% crop.
pests.economic_threshold: 1 larva per 5 plants OR 5% fruit damage
pests.biological_control: Install pheromone traps (5/acre) for early detection. Release Trichogramma chilonis (1 lakh/acre) weekly during fruiting. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis kurstaki @ 2 kg/acre. Intercrop with Agathi (Sesbania grandiflora).
pests.chemical_control: Spray Spinosad 45 SC @ 3 ml/15L or Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 2g/15L. Rotate with Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC. Never use same molecule twice consecutively.

pests.symptoms: Yellowing, curling, crinkling of leaves. Stunted growth. Honeydew and sooty mold. Transmits deadly Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV).
pests.economic_threshold: 10 adults per plant or first appearance of virus symptoms
pests.biological_control: Install yellow sticky traps (15/acre). Spray insecticidal soap (5 ml/L) or NSKE 5% preventively. Release Encarsia formosa parasitoid (2,000/acre/week).
pests.chemical_control: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 3 ml/15L. Alternate with Spiromesifen 22.9 SC @ 10 ml/15L. Avoid pyrethroid sprays (repels natural enemies).

pests.symptoms: Fine webbing on undersurface of leaves. Stippling/bronzing of leaves. Severe damage in hot dry weather.
pests.economic_threshold: 10 mites per leaflet or visible webbing on multiple plants
pests.biological_control: Release predatory mite Phytoseiulus persimilis (20/plant). Maintain field humidity by irrigation. Spray neem oil (5 ml/L) as preventive.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Spiromesifen 22.9 SC @ 10 ml/15L or Abamectin 1.9 EC @ 5 ml/15L. Never spray during high temperatures.

pests.symptoms: White spiralling egg masses on undersurface of fronds. Heavy sooty mold. Premature nut fall. Yellowing fronds.
pests.economic_threshold: Visible spiralling egg masses on lower fronds
pests.biological_control: Release Encarsia guadeloupae (introduced biocontrol agent) — 15 adults/tree. Install yellow sticky traps with castor oil (5/acre). Apply Verticillium lecanii (2.5 kg/acre) in cooler months.
pests.chemical_control: Apply systemic insecticide via root feeding method only during severe outbreaks. Avoid foliar sprays to protect pollinators (honeybees).

pests.symptoms: Chewed leaf bases, oozing of brownish liquid from crown, characteristic fermenting odour. Tunnelling in stem. Can kill the palm.
pests.economic_threshold: First sign of crown damage or oozing sap
pests.biological_control: Install pheromone traps (2 traps/acre) with Ferrugineol lure for mass trapping. Apply Metarhizium anisopliae in manure pits. Fill stem tunnels with Beauveria bassiana + sand paste.
pests.chemical_control: Inject 1% Chlorpyrifos solution into stem tunnels using a hand pump. Seal the crown with insecticide-treated paste as prophylactic measure.

pests.symptoms: Upward curling of leaves (chilli curl disease), silvering, scarring. Thrips also vector of Tomato Spotted Wilt Virus (TSWV).
pests.economic_threshold: 10 thrips per plant or virus symptom appearance
pests.biological_control: Install blue sticky traps (15/acre). Release Chrysoperla carnea (50,000/acre). Spray NSKE 5% preventively every 10 days. Intercrop with coriander to attract predators.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Spinosad 45 SC @ 3 ml/15L or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 2.5 ml/15L. Alternate chemical classes to prevent resistance.

pests.symptoms: Circular holes at the tip of fruits. Larvae feeding inside, causing rotting. Premature fruit drop.
pests.economic_threshold: 2% fruit damage
pests.biological_control: Install pheromone traps with Heliothis lure. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis @ 2 kg/acre at egg hatching stage. Release Trichogramma chilonis (1 lakh/acre).
pests.chemical_control: Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 2g/15L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 3 ml/15L. Apply in the evening.

pests.symptoms: Reddish tunnels inside internodes. Stalk breakage at wind. Reduced sugar content. Dead heart in early stage.
pests.economic_threshold: 5% dead hearts or 5% internode damage
pests.biological_control: Release Trichogramma chilonis (1 lakh/acre) at 15-day intervals. Release Sturmiopsis inferens (gravid females) 4 times per season. Set up light traps for adult monitoring.
pests.chemical_control: Apply Sett treatment with Propiconazole + Imidacloprid before planting. For field infestation, apply Chlorpyrifos granules @ 5 kg/acre in leaf axils.

pests.symptoms: White cottony masses at leaf sheaths. Yellow discolouration. 'Grassy shoot' disease transmission. Ants tending mealybugs.
pests.economic_threshold: 10 mealybugs per plant
pests.biological_control: Release Cryptolaemus montrouzieri (mealybug destroyer beetle) — 50/acre. Apply NSKE 5% spray. Remove ant colonies near affected plants.
pests.chemical_control: Drench base of plant with Chlorpyrifos 20 EC @ 10 ml/L. Spray Dimethoate 30 EC for foliar application.

pests.symptoms: Yellow mosaic pattern on leaves — signature of Yellow Mosaic Virus (YMV). Severely reduces pod set. Can cause 100% yield loss.
pests.economic_threshold: 1 viruliferous whitefly per plant (zero tolerance for virus vectors)
pests.biological_control: Raise sunflower as intercrop/border to attract whitefly natural enemies. Set up yellow sticky traps (15/acre). Remove and destroy virus-infected plants immediately.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Acetamiprid 20 SP @ 5g/15L or Thiamethoxam 25 WDG @ 5g/15L. Begin spraying at 15 days after emergence as preventive.

pests.symptoms: Webbing of leaves and pods. Larvae feeding inside pods causing extensive grain damage.
pests.economic_threshold: 5% pod damage
pests.biological_control: Set up bird perches (4/acre). Spray Bacillus thuringiensis @ 2 kg/acre at pod initiation. Install pheromone traps for population monitoring.
pests.chemical_control: Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 2g/15L or Spinosad 45 SC @ 3 ml/15L at pod development stage.

pests.symptoms: Dead heart — central shoot drying out. Loss of young seedlings. Higher incidence in late-sown crops.
pests.economic_threshold: 10% dead hearts in seedling stage
pests.biological_control: Early sowing to escape peak fly population. Apply Neem cake @ 250 kg/acre in soil. Install sticky traps to monitor adult population.
pests.chemical_control: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 70 WS @ 5g/kg seed. Spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 15 ml/15L if dead heart exceeds ETL.

pests.symptoms: Dead hearts in seedling stage (shoot fly). Later, tunnelling in stem by stem borer causing dead panicle.
pests.economic_threshold: 5% dead hearts (shoot fly) OR 5% stem borer damage
pests.biological_control: Use resistant varieties (CSV 15, CSV 17). Early uniform sowing to break pest cycle. Release Cotesia spp. parasitoid. Apply Neem cake at last ploughing.
pests.chemical_control: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid. Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 3 ml/15L in stem at whorl stage for borer control.

pests.symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of leaves starting from lower leaves. Rotting of rhizome with foul smell. Plant collapse.
pests.economic_threshold: First symptom appearance — act immediately
pests.biological_control: Treat rhizomes with Trichoderma viride (4 g/kg) before planting. Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens (2.5 kg/acre) as soil drench. Use well-decomposed FYM only.
pests.chemical_control: Drench soil around affected plants with Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 2.5 g/L. Avoid waterlogging by ensuring proper drainage.
